features.name: Magic Paste
features.description: An app that allows you to paste data from external sources into Business Central with automatic or manual field mapping. Supports pasting into general journals, sales orders, customer lists, and other master tables and documents.
caveats: Currently available in 80 different places in standard Business Central
Field mapping may need manual adjustment if column names do not match Business Central field names

features.name: Automatic Column Header Detection
features.description: Magic Paste can automatically detect whether pasted data has headers and map column names to Business Central fields based on field names.
caveats: Column name matching depends on proper naming
User can override auto-detection if headers are not present

features.name: Manual Field Mapping
features.description: Users can manually map pasted columns to Business Central fields using a search function and dialog interface.

features.name: Save and Reuse Mappings
features.description: Users can save field mappings for repeated paste operations and reuse them for identical data structures.

features.name: File Drop Support
features.description: Users can drop files directly onto the paste area in addition to using clipboard paste operations.

features.name: Default Field Values
features.description: Users can set default values for fields that are not present in the pasted data.
